note: Mutants of the O(1) lookups of the simulation (a queued-request flag for each ant in PathManager, the slot of an ant's id in SimulationEngineImpl::find_unit) for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'). Run from the checkout with a configured build folder: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/engine_lookups_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 900. Every mutant must be caught by tests/test_sim/test_engine_lookups.cpp: a flag that goes stale (delivery, a rotation, clear), a copy or a move that loses the flags, a flag array that is one short, ids that are never found, a request that does not replace the old one, a slot that is not checked or is off by one, ids that are not dense.
